newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara promotion almost finalised--MOF sources.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara promotion almost finalised--MOF sources.

text.p: The promotion of Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara to the post of vice finance minister for international affairs has been nearly finalised, sources close to the ministry told Reuters on Wednesday.

The announcement of the appointment of Sakakibara, currently director of the international finance bureau and dubbed "Mr Yen" for his influence over currency markets, is expected in the middle of the month, most likely on July 15 after it is approved by the cabinet on that day, they said.
"The appointment of Sakakibara as vice finance minister is almost decided," said one source.
Vice ministerial appointments must be approved by the cabinet, and July 15 is the most likely date for the announcement, the sources said.
Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Friday that no decision had been made on any personnel issues.
Vice Finance Minister Takatoshi Kato is expected to become a special adviser to the finance minister.
Sakakibara has been credited with spearheading a drive to counter the yen's steep rise in 1995, and was instrumental in revising foreign exchange laws as a step towards Tokyo's "Big Bang" reforms.
